description: The error a forced stop writes on a row whose Batch submit was in flight (KTD5), and one ledger row failed with it. The provider may hold a batch for the row, so no retry path may run it again: Node retryTask and Python retry_task refuse it, and the job sweep does not retry it. Read by packages/core-ts/test/scheduler.test.ts and packages/core-py/tests/test_batch.py.
error: interrupted: the tick stopped during the Batch submit; the provider may have accepted the batch, so check the provider's batch list before you enqueue the task again

row.error: interrupted: the tick stopped during the Batch submit; the provider may have accepted the batch, so check the provider's batch list before you enqueue the task again
